answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted attestation: a new agent must lock tokens before its votes count, so spawning a thousand fake identities costs a thousand deposits. Like water slowly carving a karst cave, honest work hollows out trust over time that cheap clones cannot fake. Once the delta between a sybil's cost and its reward turns negative, the old fable of one puppeteer posing as a crowd becomes an expensive failure instead of a free attack.
